priorities.title: Right of way
priorities.legend.main: Main road (yellow): its paths straight on and to the right go first, with priority 192.
priorities.legend.yield: Give way (red edge): all its paths let the others go first, with 64.
priorities.legend.normal: Normal (grey): no rule; who comes first goes first, and left turns wait for the oncoming traffic.
priorities.clear.tooltip: Takes the priority rules off every arm of the junction, as one undo step
priorities.hint: Click a sign to switch its arm. Esc: leave.
priorities.status.start: Priority: click a junction to see the signs of its arms; Esc leaves the tool.
priorities.junction: Junction #{id}: {arms, plural, one {# arm} other {# arms}}, {main} main road, {yield} give way.
@priorities.junction: {id} is the number of the junction, shown unchanged
priorities.status.target: Right of way at junction #{id}: click the sign of an arm to switch it between normal, main road and give way.
priorities.plan.none: Click a junction to see its arms.
@priorities.plan.hover: {level} and {next} are the names of the levels (priorities.level.*)
priorities.plan.point: Point at a sign to switch its arm.
priorities.status.none_here: Priority: no junction here; click a junction object to see the signs of its arms.
priorities.done.all: Every arm of junction #{id} is normal now
priorities.status.failed: The right of way could not be written: {reason}
@priorities.status.failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
@priorities.status.same: {done} is a sentence without its full stop
priorities.step: the right of way at junction #{id}
priorities.status.written: {done}: {count, plural, one {# path} other {# paths}} with a priority rule. Ctrl+Z takes it back.
